prompt_en: Core concept lock: 설윤 공주 팜므파탈. Treat every generated subject, action, lighting, and camera detail as support for this concept, not a replacement. Create a fashion editorial photograph in the style of environmental portrait photography. Subject and state: an adult princess-role subject with a classic elegant presence, low bun hair, natural makeup, a cold, unreadable stare with no emotion wearing a subtle diamond tiara, a royal ball gown; action and prop: looking down toward a low camera with a dominant still pose, an ornate phoenix hairpin; make the pose, gaze, expression, hand placement, and immediate intention readable, with nearby props and background details supporting the action. Scene and location: inside a candlelit Joseon palace interior; show clear spatial depth, environmental structure, foreground, midground, and background cues. Camera and composition: a full-frame mirrorless camera, viewer seated across an interview table, eye-level frontal view, centered symmetrical composition, upper-body framing, a 50mm standard lens, precise focus on the eyes, limb motion blur with a sharp face; define subject scale, pose visibility, platform-safe frame edges, perspective, focus behavior, and any motion treatment clearly. Lighting: low flickering candlelight, side light from camera left, phone screen glow, exposure retaining deep shadows, venetian-blind stripe shadows; make shadow direction, highlights, reflected light, exposure balance, and atmosphere feel like a real photographic capture. Color and mood: luxury black-and-gold palette, occult noir mood; keep the palette, emotional tone, and world context coherent with the subject and setting. Texture, format, and finish: a subtle diamond tiara, subtle silk hanbok texture, natural makeup, a royal ball gown, vertical 4:5 social portrait aspect ratio, photorealistic and natural as if truly photographed; render skin, hair, fabric, metal, glass, makeup, and accessories with accurate material detail. Constraints: no text or watermark, anti-selfie royal profile. Prioritize a specific, image-ready photographic result over a vague style summary. Additional requirements: Treat princess as a broad adult royal archetype, not a single Joseon-only costume: choose one coherent register such as Korean court, Chinese hanfu court, Western ballroom royalty, modern royal heiress, incognito heir, or fallen/exiled royal; Royal identity must read through visible regalia, inherited-rank posture, lineage object, crest, attendants, throne/court space, official public-display context, or palace-security context, not just a pretty dress; Do not collapse every princess prompt into hanbok/Joseon palace; do not turn it into generic cosplay, pin-up monarchy, minors-coding, or disconnected fantasy costume; femme fatale reinterpreted as a powerful, intelligent, dangerous woman who controls the gaze and the situation: the symbol of potential ruin, not a sexy villainess stereotype; she is the subject who watches and decides; the camera or viewer is the one being observed and unsettled through gaze reversal; keep the role outfit readable; the femme fatale layer changes power, posture, gaze direction, light, and symbolic props rather than turning the image into lingerie, cleavage-centric framing, or a pin-up; express danger through noir and symbolist grammar: chiaroscuro, deep shadow, reflection or doubling, threshold framing, wilted-flower or poison omen, and withheld intent; make intelligence and leverage visible in the frame: at least one information-control anchor such as a sealed file, guest book, ledger, calling card, phone message, key, decree, or withheld result should sit near her face, hand, table edge, or foreground, not only in the mood; danger may also be expressed as magnetic, deliberate allure where being drawn in is itself the trap: a honey-trap or spider-and-web register in which she chooses the encounter, sets the lure, and reads the mark; this is still agency, intelligence, and control, never passive availability or submission; agency over availability: no come-hither pose, no bedroom-eyes expression, no parted-lips invitation, no submissive posture, no nudity, no explicit or fetish content, and no depicted violence, blood, victim, or injury; frame her through face, eyes, hands, and symbolic evidence in an upper-body, head-and-shoulders, waist-up, or detail crop; if a low-angle camera is used, frame it as dominance through face, eyes, posture, and stance from a respectful distance, never as an objectifying full-body or pin-up body angle; the princess styling reads as political power and lethal intelligence in a poisoned court, not decorative beauty; the phoenix hairpin catches a quiet omen-like glint, with an unsigned decree or sealed court order nearby as the information she may reveal or destroy; she is the one who decides fates in this court. Inspired by the described styling and vibe; an original adult fictional person, not an exact likeness of any real individual.
prompt_ko: 핵심 컨셉 잠금: 설윤 공주 팜므파탈. 아래의 피사체, 동작, 조명, 카메라 디테일은 이 컨셉을 대체하지 않고 보조해야 한다. 패션 에디토리얼 화보로 렌더링할 환경 인물 사진. 중심 피사체와 상태: 클래식하고 우아한 인상의 낮게 묶은 로우 번 헤어 자연스러운 내추럴 메이크업 감정이 읽히지 않는 차가운 응시의 절제된 다이아 티아라를 착용한 왕실 무도회 드레스를 입은 공주 역할의 성인 인물; 동작과 소품: 아래의 카메라를 내려다보는 강한 포즈, 봉황 장식 비녀; 피사체의 자세, 시선, 표정, 손동작, 즉각적인 동작 의도가 한눈에 읽히게 하고, 주변 소품과 배경 요소는 그 행동을 설명하도록 배치한다. 장면과 장소: 촛불이 켜진 조선 궁궐 실내에서; 공간의 깊이, 바닥/벽/하늘 또는 실내 구조, 전경/중경/후경의 거리감을 분명히 보여준다. 카메라와 구도: 풀프레임 미러리스 카메라, 시청자가 면접자/심문자 맞은편인 POV, 눈높이 정면 시점, 정중앙 대칭 구도, 상반신 중심 프레이밍, 50mm 표준 렌즈, 눈에 정확히 맞은 초점, 팔다리는 흔들리고 얼굴은 선명한 움직임; 피사체 크기, 포즈 가시성, 플랫폼 안전 프레임, 프레임 가장자리, 원근감, 초점 위치, 움직임 처리를 명확히 한다. 조명: 촛불처럼 흔들리는 낮은 조명, 왼쪽에서 들어오는 측면광, 휴대폰 화면빛, 짙은 그림자가 남아 있는 노출, 베네시안 블라인드 줄무늬 그림자; 그림자 방향, 하이라이트, 반사광, 노출 균형, 대기감을 실제 촬영처럼 보이게 한다. 색감과 분위기: 검정과 금색의 럭셔리 팔레트, 오컬트 누아르의 어둡고 불온한 정서;
